context_purpose: A residential committee wants some evidence that a courier or concierge hire is reliable before giving access to a package room or building tags.

norm_violation_today.reason: Screenshots expose earnings, order history and work zones when only reliability is relevant.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A platform rating says nothing about criminal history or trustworthiness around access-controlled premises, which a police certificate would cover.

transmission_check.reason: The courier volunteers evidence to get a job or access, and no law is known to require the screenshots.

context_purpose: An organisation working with minors must confirm the person is not barred from such work under child and youth protection rules.

norm_violation_today.reason: The organisation needs only a barred or not-barred answer but receives a full record certificate plus ID, address and household data.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for the legal check itself; the organisation loses sight of unrelated offences that might matter to its own discretionary judgement.

transmission_check.reason: A duty to check exists in some settings but I cannot say whether the rules name a specific certificate form.

context_purpose: A private seller or pickup service wants reassurance that the counterparty is a trustworthy trader before a high-value handover.

norm_violation_today.reason: Feedback is public by design, but linking to the profile also exposes listings, history and location hints beyond the reputation fact.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A threshold proof cannot detect a bought or rented account, nor show recent behaviour or the specific complaints a human could read.

transmission_check.reason: The counterparty is free to accept any evidence and nothing obliges collection of the profile.

context_purpose: A boarding operator wants assurance that a traveller is not carrying a notifiable infection on departure day.

norm_violation_today.reason: Operators keep photocopies of lab reports with ID and diagnosis context when a time-limited yes/no would serve.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The operator cannot see test type or result detail, which is rarely needed for a boarding decision.

transmission_check.reason: Port or quarantine rules might require records, and I cannot say what they demand in Taiwan.

context_purpose: Site security wants to admit only couriers currently active with a recognised logistics operator.

norm_violation_today.reason: Checking a worker card is normal access control, but photographing ID, plate and phone for many daily visitors exceeds the standing check.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Sites often want a name or plate for incident tracing, which a bare standing proof does not supply.

transmission_check.reason: Site rules are set by each premises and I cannot tell whether identity logging is mandated.

context_purpose: A landlord or agent wants confidence that a prospective tenant is stably employed and able to pay rent. Note: the title (night-market stall helper, phone plan) does not match the landlord moment described.

norm_violation_today.reason: A pay slip hands over salary, ID number and address when the stated need is only current employment.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Landlords commonly judge rent-to-income, which a current-employment flag cannot show.

transmission_check.reason: The tenant volunteers documents to win a tenancy and no statute is known to require a pay slip.

context_purpose: A concession desk wants to confirm the person at the counter is an enrolled student entitled to the discounted fare.

norm_violation_today.reason: Glancing at a student card and ID is normal, but photographing both for the sales record keeps more than the entitlement needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The clerk's visual photo comparison is still needed, which a match proof does not replace.

transmission_check.reason: The fare rule needs proof of student status, and no known law requires copying the cards.

context_purpose: A county bureau must confirm an applicant's electricity account is in the eligible contract class before awarding a grant.

norm_violation_today.reason: Bills disclose consumption and capacity that reveal business operations while only the contract class matters.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The bureau still needs the site address and an inspection for the project record and final approval.

transmission_check.reason: Grant rules may name specific documents and I cannot say whether a class-membership proof would be accepted.
